               B|    Other   buying   verbs                                                                        |
                     Learn these verbs in pairs to help you remember them.
                     We  should stock up on fruit and vegetables and not buy so much junk food. [buy large quantities of]
                     We should  never skimp on healthy foods. [spend too little money on or use too little of]
                     We splashed  out [spent a lot of money on something we didn’t really need] on lots of new furniture
                     last month and ran up [caused ourselves to have to pay] a huge bill.
                     I've had this email about an online offer. They're selling off printers, [selling to get rid of them]
                     Should | buy one right away in case they sell out? (have none left]


                        Sometimes you meet pairs of phrasal verbs which you can link together into one sentence or a

                                                                                        many  pairs of phrasal
